title: Champyon Taekwondo USA Inc.

services.name: TaeKwonDo Tenets
services.desc: ChampYon Taekwondo was founded on the South side of Chicago by Grandmaster Luciano when his own Instructor passed on his own school to him in 1982. He then dedicated his life towards spreading the love of Taekwondo to everyone he has encountered and grew the brand to the International reputation we hold today. With Grandmaster Medina, his wife, and two children, Masters Christian and Nedra Medina as full-time instructors, ChampYon TaeKwonDo is the true definition of a family business. Our values stem from Grandmaster Medina's teaching and understanding of the Martial Art. We prioritize teaching the TaeKwonDo Tenets as they form the foundation of the art's philosophy and character

blurb: ChampYon TaeKwonDo is a family-owned martial arts academy servicing the East Side of Chicago since 1982. We provide classes for children and adults ages 4 and up, with a focus on developing self-defense skills and building confidence.
